verdict.rationale: Weave documents a public Service API of REST endpoints for programmatic access to its functionality. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec, and the Python/TypeScript SDKs, an OTLP ingest endpoint and an official MCP server give further programmatic control. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through the REST API, and evidence of how far the endpoints cover what the UI can do.
